mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'MI') AS REG_DTTM , COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM CLOVER_API_LOG a WHERE TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDDHH24') = COALESCE(#{hour}, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24')) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'MI') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'MI')

SELECT TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'HH24') AS REG_DTTM , COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM CLOVER_API_LOG a WHERE TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD') = COALESCE(#{day}, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'HH24') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'HH24')

SELECT ( SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD'), 1, 4) || '년' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD'), 5, 2) || '월' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD'), 7, 2) || '일' ) AS REG_DTTM , COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM CLOVER_API_LOG a WHERE TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMM') = COALESCE(#{month}, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMM')) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD')

SELECT TO_CHAR(REQ_DTTM, 'YYYYMM') AS REG_DTTM , COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM CLOVER_API_LOG A WHERE TO_CHAR(REQ_DTTM, 'YYYYMMDD') <= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(REQ_DTTM, 'YYYYMM') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(REQ_DTTM, 'YYYYMM')

SELECT X.API_URL AS API_URL , Y.API_URL_NM AS API_URL_NM , X.CNT AS PROC_TM_MAX FROM ( SELECT API_URL , COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM CLOVER_API_LOG a WHERE POSITION('/p/' IN API_URL) = 0 GROUP BY API_URL ) X LEFT JOIN CLOVER_API_PAGE Y ON REPLACE(X.API_URL, '/zero-rule-server', '') = Y.API_URL ORDER BY X.CNT DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT X.API_URL AS API_URL , Y.API_URL_NM AS API_URL_NM , X.MAX_TM AS CNT FROM ( SELECT API_URL , ROUND(MAX(PROC_TM) / 1000, 3) AS MAX_TM FROM CLOVER_API_LOG WHERE REQ_DTTM >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '6 months' AND POSITION('/p/' IN API_URL) = 0 GROUP BY API_URL ) X LEFT JOIN CLOVER_API_PAGE Y ON REPLACE(X.API_URL, '/zero-rule-server', '') = Y.API_URL ORDER BY X.MAX_TM DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMM') AS REG_DTTM , ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(PROC_TM, 0)), 0) / 1000 AS AVG_TIME FROM CLOVER_API_LOG a WHERE TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD') >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months', 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMM') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMM')

SELECT ( SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD'), 1, 4) || '년' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD'), 5, 2) || '월' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD'), 7, 2) || '일' ) AS REG_DTTM , ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(PROC_TM, 0)), 0) / 1000 AS AVG_TIME FROM CLOVER_API_LOG a WHERE TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMM') = COALESCE(#{month}, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMM')) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD')

SELECT TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'HH24') AS REG_DTTM , ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(PROC_TM, 0)), 0) / 1000 AS AVG_TIME FROM CLOVER_API_LOG a WHERE TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD') = COALESCE(#{day}, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'HH24') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'HH24')

SELECT TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'MI') AS REG_DTTM , ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(PROC_TM, 0)), 0) / 1000 AS AVG_TIME FROM CLOVER_API_LOG a WHERE TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDDHH24') = COALESCE(#{hour}, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24')) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'MI') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'MI')

SELECT TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMM') AS REG_DTTM , ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(PROC_TM, 0)), 0) / 1000 AS LATE_TIME FROM CLOVER_API_LOG WHERE req_dttm >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '6 months' AND POSITION('/p/' IN API_URL) = 0 AND API_URL IN ( SELECT X.API_URL FROM ( SELECT API_URL , MAX(PROC_TM) AS MAX_TM FROM CLOVER_API_LOG WHERE req_dttm >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '6 months' AND POSITION('/p/' IN API_URL) = 0 GROUP BY API_URL ) X LEFT JOIN CLOVER_API_PAGE Y ON REPLACE(X.API_URL, '/rule-server', '') = Y.API_URL ORDER BY X.MAX_TM DESC LIMIT 10 ) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMM') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMM')

SELECT ( SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD'), 1, 4) || '년' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD'), 5, 2) || '월' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD'), 7, 2) || '일' ) AS REG_DTTM , ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(PROC_TM, 0)), 0) / 1000 AS LATE_TIME FROM CLOVER_API_LOG WHERE TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMM') = COALESCE(#{month}, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMM')) AND POSITION('/p/' IN API_URL) = 0 AND API_URL IN ( SELECT X.API_URL FROM ( SELECT API_URL , MAX(PROC_TM) AS MAX_TM FROM CLOVER_API_LOG WHERE req_dttm >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '6 months' AND POSITION('/p/' IN API_URL) = 0 GROUP BY API_URL ) X LEFT JOIN CLOVER_API_PAGE Y ON REPLACE(X.API_URL, '/rule-server', '') = Y.API_URL ORDER BY X.MAX_TM DESC LIMIT 10 ) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD')

SELECT TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'HH24') AS REG_DTTM , ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(PROC_TM, 0)), 0) / 1000 AS LATE_TIME FROM CLOVER_API_LOG WHERE TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDD') = COALESCE(#{day}, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) AND POSITION('/p/' IN API_URL) = 0 AND API_URL IN ( SELECT X.API_URL FROM ( SELECT API_URL , MAX(PROC_TM) AS MAX_TM FROM CLOVER_API_LOG WHERE req_dttm >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '6 months' AND POSITION('/p/' IN API_URL) = 0 GROUP BY API_URL ) X LEFT JOIN CLOVER_API_PAGE Y ON REPLACE(X.API_URL, '/rule-server', '') = Y.API_URL ORDER BY X.MAX_TM DESC LIMIT 10 ) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'HH24') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'HH24')

SELECT TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'MI') AS REG_DTTM , ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(PROC_TM, 0)), 0) / 1000 AS LATE_TIME FROM CLOVER_API_LOG WHERE TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'YYYYMMDDHH24') = COALESCE(#{hour}, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24')) AND POSITION('/p/' IN API_URL) = 0 AND API_URL IN ( SELECT X.API_URL FROM ( SELECT API_URL , MAX(PROC_TM) AS MAX_TM FROM CLOVER_API_LOG WHERE req_dttm >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '6 months' AND POSITION('/p/' IN API_URL) = 0 GROUP BY API_URL ) X LEFT JOIN CLOVER_API_PAGE Y ON REPLACE(X.API_URL, '/rule-server', '') = Y.API_URL ORDER BY X.MAX_TM DESC LIMIT 10 ) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'MI') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(req_dttm, 'MI')
SELECT COALESCE(C.TEAM_NM, '무소속') AS TASK , COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM CLOVER_API_LOG A JOIN CLOVER_USER B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CLOVER_TEAM C ON B.TEAM_ID = C.TEAM_ID GROUP BY C.TEAM_NM
